I’m not able to pull live data from external databases right now, but I can give you a quick snapshot based on the most recent publicly‑available figures.

| Metric | Value (2024 estimate) |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Median home price** | ≈ $800 000 |
| **Average (mean) home price** | ≈ $850 000–$900 000 |

> **Why the difference?**  
> The median is the middle value of all listings, so it’s less affected by a handful of very expensive properties. The mean (average) pulls up when a few high‑priced homes skew the distribution, which is why it tends to be a bit higher than the median in California’s market.

If you need the exact figure for a specific county or a more granular breakdown, let me know and I can point you toward the latest Zillow/Redfin reports or the U.S. Census ACS data.
